per_step.command:
# Process each patient and collect results
results="["
first=true

for pid in P1001 P1002 P1003 P1004 P1005; do
  severity=$(/usr/local/bin/assess_urgency.sh "$pid")
  echo "Patient $pid: severity=$severity"
  assignment=$(/usr/local/bin/assign_resources.sh "$pid" "$severity")
  echo "Assignment: $assignment"
  
  if [ "$first" = true ]; then
    results="$results$assignment"
    first=false
  else
    results="$results,$assignment"
  fi
done

results="$results]"
echo "$results" > /app/output/resource_allocations.json
echo "Saved to /app/output/resource_allocations.json"

# Calculate average wait time and average resource utilization
cat /app/output/resource_allocations.json | jq -r '
  (map(.wait_time_minutes) | add / length) as $avg_wait |
  (map(.resource_utilization) | add / length) as $avg_util |
  "Average Wait Time: \($avg_wait) minutes (target: < 30)",
  "Average Resource Utilization: \($avg_util)% (target: > 95%)",
  "KPI Status:",
  "  Wait Time: " + (if $avg_wait < 30 then "PASS" else "FAIL - exceeds 30 min target" end),
  "  Utilization: " + (if $avg_util > 95 then "PASS" else "FAIL - below 95% target" end)
'
